in_marathi.name: Srishti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Srishti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Srishti is a name derived from the Sanskrit and Hindi language, which means 'creation', 'manifestation', or 'establishment'. It is a popular name among Hindus and is often given to a child as a symbol of good fortune and the belief that they will bring something new and beautiful into the world.
